counter_binding: Parent supplies current actual external full8 process GPUh, including failed runs; reserved_elsewhere excludes this phase and covers dev/recovery/E3/other allocations. Optional source {path,sha256} entries are hashed independently; no stale 8/40 values reused.
dispatch_rule: Before first job and each subsequent job: actual current phase + ALL remaining job reserves <= phase_limit and + external spent + reserved_elsewhere <= total_internal_limit
in_flight_overrun: Never terminate current job. Charge its actual wall on exit and refuse next if limits no longer admit all remaining reservations; final budget compliance reported separately.
